facts: Official 2018 notice says consumers may not resell goods already purchased through cross-border ecommerce retail import. This policy does not establish admission of commercial inventory through general trade.

Customs consignee/consignor filing guide accepts qualifying market entities including companies and sole proprietors (individual businesses). Application can use singlewindow or customs portal, with market-entity qualification. Filing is separate from product admission.
Legal-basis section still repeats foreign-trade-operator registration. Read with I3; do not retain that abolished prerequisite. Administrative filing listed free; not total import cost.
MOFCOM announcement dated 2023-01-03 says foreign-trade-operator registration ceased on 2022-12-30 after Foreign Trade Law Article9 deletion. Do not conflate this with customs filing.

Statutory inspection guide applies to goods in the inspection catalogue or otherwise required by law. Consignee/consignor or agent submits declarations and supporting documents; customs determines onsite inspection/testing by applicable rules/risk.

Listed documents include contract, invoice, packing list, transport bill and agency authorization; export entry also lists factory inspection proof. Import safety/health/environment failure can mean return/destruction; other failures may require supervised rectification and reinspection before sale/use.

This is a generic guide, not a decision that Joan or AKIRA is in the catalogue or admitted as used merchandise. Exact HS, CCC scope, used-toy restrictions, taxes and practical document sufficiency remain unknown.

Direct open failed (Internal Error). Third-party discovery references 2026 toy CCC rules but not accepted as primary verified rule text. No definitive CCC exemption or effective-date conclusion from this record.
Current official page describes enterprise application subject to initial checks, human approval, business location/category and additional documentation such as business plan.

Enterprise-channel FAQ says companies other than individual businesses, registered at least one year; separate FAQ says personal sellers can join eBay. Do not turn this channel requirement into a total ban on all personal/individual-business sales or guarantee user approval.

Current page says individual account cannot convert to enterprise account. Specific chosen seller/entity eligibility, collectibles category approval, fees and account capabilities remain unverified. Old search snippet differs from direct current application wording.
Official guide last modified2026-02-02 describes invitation-triggered eBay/Payoneer linkage; account types and identity/business documents must match, followed by verification and approval.
A described payment channel is not the user's approved account. Full current onboarding requirements, settlement/FX/withdrawal fees, timing, holds and refunds remain unknown.

Classification weighs reasonable manufacturer intended-use statement, packaging/display/marketing, common consumer recognition and age-determination guidelines. A label alone does not determine classification.

Adult collectible features can matter but neither price nor collector label automatically excludes children's-product status. Some regulated general-use products still require GCC. Actual Joan/AKIRA classification has not been determined.
Consumer-to-consumer online sales are commercial; personal gift exemption does not cover sales.

For used products manufactured before the relevant CPSC rule/ban/standard took effect, no certificate/eFiling requirement arises on that basis; eFiling does not create a certificate requirement where none previously existed.

For used products manufactured after an applicable rule took effect and already subject to certification, commercial import still requires certification/eFiling. Not a blanket exemption for all vintage/used goods or all pre2008 goods.
Need actual manufacture date, version, applicable rules and importer responsibilities. Seller's '2000' title alone insufficient. Resold/overstock finished regulated goods also covered.

Official guidance states general import certificate/eFiling update effective2026-07-08; FTZ entries have2027-01-08 date. Applies to products subject to CPSC certification requirements, not every collectible automatically.
Official technical documentation references split payout facilities for Mainland China sellers. Confirms a supported seller population, not current applicant approval or authority to implement API.
